first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so shortening onboarding directly targets the two observed problems while improving time-to-value without broadly discounting the product. Verify the prior onboarding result before committing; run a controlled experiment because reducing onboarding steps could weaken education, qualification, or downstream customer value.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding-shortening experiment this week. The verified source shows higher completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and a 3% lift in 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Keep the rollout controlled to monitor downstream activation quality, retention, and qualified revenue rather than optimizing completion alone.
